judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across tool rounds while ignoring missing rounds and preserving undefined when no rounds report usage, satisfying all acceptance criteria. However, it leaves a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the commit and introduces a `TurnUsage` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts` without updating the doc-block in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` or `CLAUDE.md` to match the changed `OrchestratorHooks` signature (whereas the reference simply renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and kept all doc-blocks in sync). Additionally, while the reference added two concise tests directly into `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the candidate extracted test helpers into a new production-directory file (`src/orchestration/orchestratorTestSupport.ts`) and created two separate test files with overlapping test cases. Finally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate placed the new behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading instead of moving it to the active specification section as the reference did.
